meta.method: Occupation-level O*NET interests; UK salary/openings are broader SOC-group proxies, not occupation-specific counts.

areas.label: Accounting
areas.description: Work involves examining, analyzing, and interpreting accounting records for financial statements, or maintaining, auditing, or evaluating records and accounts.

areas.label: Agriculture
areas.description: Work involves planting, cultivating, and harvesting crops, plants, or trees, or raising farm animals. Work can also involve preparing plant and animal products for distribution to consumers, or protecting natural resources to maximize their use in farming.

areas.label: Animal Service
areas.description: Work involves feeding, grooming, exercising, or otherwise providing care to promote and maintain the well-being of pets and other animals in settings such as kennels, animal shelters, and zoos.

areas.label: Applied Arts and Design
areas.description: Work involves applying artistic principles to the design and creation of various objects and materials.

areas.label: Athletics
areas.description: Work involves training, practicing, or competing in athletic events, or supporting those participating in athletics through coaching, training, or officiating.

areas.label: Business Initiatives
areas.description: Work involves creating strategic plans or taking actions to expand an organization's business or market share.

areas.label: Construction/Woodwork
areas.description: Work involves constructing, installing, or repairing structures and fixtures made of wood.

areas.label: Creative Writing
areas.description: Work involves developing creative written works, such as novels, scripts, song lyrics, poetry, stories, or advertisements.

areas.label: Culinary Art
areas.description: Work involves preparing, cooking, and presenting food in a distinctive style usually associated with a specific culture or region.

areas.label: Engineering
areas.description: Work involves applying science and technology to the design, building, testing, and use of electrical and electronic components, mechanical devices and machines, automotive, marine, and aerospace equipment and vehicles, materials, or structures.

areas.label: Finance
areas.description: Work involves directing and managing financial activities, such as planning and investments for an individual or organization to generate income.

areas.label: Health Care Service
areas.description: Work involves providing health care services to individuals to include the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases and other forms of illness or impairment.

areas.label: Human Resources
areas.description: Work involves recruiting, selecting, and training job applicants, maintaining employee personnel records, administering compensation and employee-benefit programs, and conducting employee performance reviews.

areas.label: Humanities
areas.description: Work involves studying and researching aspects of human history, culture, and language through disciplines such as history, philosophy, the language arts, or area/ethnic studies.

areas.label: Information Technology
areas.description: Work involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining computer software, hardware, networks, and systems.

areas.label: Law
areas.description: Work involves studying and applying legal knowledge.

areas.label: Life Science
areas.description: Work involves studying and researching living organisms through scientific disciplines such as biology, botany, zoology, microbiology, physiology, biochemistry, or zoology.

areas.label: Management/Administration
areas.description: Work involves planning, directing, or coordinating the daily operations of an organization, and overseeing personnel, business, or administrative services.

areas.label: Marketing/Advertising
areas.description: Work involves promoting or creating a public image for products, services, or organizations to attract interest, engagement, or sales.

areas.label: Mathematics/Statistics
areas.description: Work involves developing and applying mathematics and statistical theory and methods.

areas.label: Mechanics/Electronics
areas.description: Work involves maintaining and repairing of machinery, such as automotive engines, electronic equipment, computers, and communication systems.

areas.label: Media
areas.description: Work involves producing, developing, writing, directing, or presenting information through print, radio, television, or digital media.

areas.label: Medical Science
areas.description: Work involves studying and researching the causes, nature, effects, and treatments of disease or other forms of impairment or illness.

areas.label: Music
areas.description: Work involves conducting, composing, or playing music or singing.

areas.label: Nature/Outdoors
areas.description: Work involves planning, restoring, and conserving natural areas and wildlife habitats.

areas.label: Office Work
areas.description: Work involves clerical and administrative tasks for an organization such as answering phones, bookkeeping, updating records, scheduling appointments or meetings, and editing of documents and files.

areas.label: Performing Arts
areas.description: Work involves acting as a performer in dance, comedy, or dramatic productions, choreographing of dance performances, or producing of live or recorded entertainment.

areas.label: Personal Service
areas.description: Work involves providing personal services to individuals in need of non-medical assistance such as helping arrange or plan for travel, meals, or events.

areas.label: Physical Science
areas.description: Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, materials, and phenomena through scientific disciplines such as physics, chemistry, astronomy, meteorology, or geology.

areas.label: Physical/Manual Labor
areas.description: Work involves manually unloading and moving freight, stock, luggage, or other materials, or performing other physical labor.

areas.label: Politics
areas.description: Work involves engaging in political activities to influence government policy.

areas.label: Professional Advising
areas.description: Work involves providing expert advice, coaching, and counseling on topics such as careers, educational opportunities, and educational and professional development.

areas.label: Protective Service
areas.description: Work involves maintaining order and protecting life and property by conducting investigations and enforcing laws and regulations to prevent or solve crimes.

areas.label: Public Speaking
areas.description: Work involves speaking before an audience to educate, entertain, or influence the listeners.

areas.label: Religious Activities
areas.description: Work involves conducting religious worship, leading a church or other religious group, and offering moral guidance associated with beliefs and practices of a religious faith.

areas.label: Sales
areas.description: Work involves selling goods or services.

areas.label: Social Science
areas.description: Work involves studying and researching human behavior, society, politics, and social relationships through scientific disciplines such as psychology, sociology, economics, or political science.

areas.label: Social Service
areas.description: Work involves providing social services and assistance to improve the well-being and social and psychological functioning of children and adults.

areas.label: Teaching/Education
areas.description: Work involves teaching through lectures, discussions, and demonstrations in one or more subjects.

areas.label: Transportation/Machine Operation
areas.description: Work involves driving vehicles, such as vans, trucks, trains, and buses to transport people or materials. Work can also involve operating heavy equipment, such as cranes, forklifts, bulldozers, and backhoes to move materials or earth.

areas.label: Visual Arts
areas.description: Work involves creating original visual artwork for a variety of media and purposes using various techniques and software.
